faq.a1: Map-6 is a free interactive map for GTA 6, including Vice City and surrounding areas, with POIs, collectibles, coordinates, and search.
faq.q2: How do I find collectibles on the GTA 6 map?
faq.a2: Open the interactive map, filter by Collectibles category, or browse /collectibles for category pages with map links.
faq.a3: Map tiles are community-sourced from GTADB (CC BY 4.0) and updated as the mapping community releases new data.
